interface.meaning: Normative routing predicate: the identified contract states the specified reverse-engineering prohibition as a norm, together with its source-specific exception. Its truth does not require an observed regulated act or a known exception event.
interface.name: contract_states_conditional_reverse_engineering_prohibition

interface.meaning: Applicability routing predicate: the identified contract's particular reverse-engineering prohibition applies in the stated ground context. A negative result only disables this extracted prohibition because its explicit exception applies; it does not establish that the conduct is permitted by other clauses or law.
interface.name: conditional_reverse_engineering_prohibition_applies

interface.meaning: The entire p1 exception applies: the Discloser specifically authorized the otherwise prohibited conduct in advance and in writing. The predicate is not satisfied by later authorization, non-written authorization, nonspecific authorization, or authorization from someone other than the Discloser.
interface.name: p1_advance_written_discloser_authorization_exception_applies

interface.meaning: The entire p2 exception applies: the otherwise prohibited conduct is pursuant to an agreement that is mutually acceptable to the parties, written, and executed by the parties. Mere negotiations, unilateral acceptance, an unwritten understanding, or an unexecuted writing do not satisfy this predicate.
interface.name: p2_mutually_acceptable_executed_written_agreement_exception_applies

arguments: decompile, disassemble, reverse engineer, or attempt by any means to reconstruct, identify, or discover source code, underlying ideas, techniques, or algorithms
decompile, disassemble, reverse engineer, or attempt by any means to reconstruct, identify, or discover source code, underlying ideas, techniques, or algorithms

policies.source_quote: 5. No Reverse Engineering. No party, as Recipient, will decompile, disassemble, reverse engineer or attempt to reconstruct, identify or discover any source code, underlying ideas, techniques or algorithms in Confidential Information by any means whatever, except as may be specifically authorized in advance by Discloser in writing.

arguments: samples, prototypes or products of the Originating Party
reverse-engineer, analyze, attempt to duplicate, or otherwise attempt to determine the design or method of compiling
samples, prototypes or products of the Originating Party
reverse-engineer, analyze, attempt to duplicate, or otherwise attempt to determine the design or method of compiling

policies.source_quote: IV. NO REVERSE ENGINEERING; WORK PRODUCT: Receiving Party shall not reverse-engineer, analyze, attempt to duplicate or otherwise attempt to determine the design or method of compiling samples, prototypes or products of the Originating Party except pursuant to a mutually acceptable, written agreement executed by the parties.

unresolved: An applicability query remains unresolved when neither polarity of its matching source-qualified exception atom is supplied.
Conflicting positive and negative inputs for the same exception atom remain unresolved.
Atoms outside the two declared normative queries and two declared applicability queries are unsupported by this focused cache.
